reasons: The candidate multiplies the series by the constant 100, which is not in the Datadog source (system.load.5 is an unscaled load average). Rules forbid numeric constants not in the source, so the expression must be dropped.

The OTel metric system.cpu.load_average.5m is a gauge with unit {thread} and measures the same 5-minute load average, so the exact translation is avg({otel_metric_name="system.cpu.load_average.5m", otel_metric_type="gauge"}).
Grouping, aggregation and series are otherwise consistent: no grouping, avg across series, and the {$scope} variable with no prefix and default * is dropped.
Outcome translated is correct because an exact translation exists; only the promql is wrong.
